topic: Tools outrun the gatekeepers — Hawking in laser wheelchair
new_body_text: Tools outran the gatekeepers. **First thing made: Hawking in a laser wheelchair.**
new_caption:
Every era of filmmaking has a moment where the tools outrun the gatekeepers. Sound did it. Color did it. CGI did it.

This is that moment — except the first thing anyone made with the new tools is Stephen Hawking in a laser wheelchair fighting Neil deGrasse Tyson over the fate of the multiverse.

The greats would be proud. Probably.

🎥 @aiordieshow
